svg.title: Two surface candidates mapped into one coupled common cell
svg.desc: The first two panels show distinct primitive surface nets and their candidate supercells. The final panel overlays both nets after one shared integer basis relabeling and separate orientation-preserving Cartesian maps place them in the same periodic cell.
